title: Garry Tan Open Sourced His Claude Code Setup (gstack, 129k Stars)
description:
gstack is the Y Combinator president's own Claude Code configuration: 23 opinionated tools shaped as company roles rather than coding tools, covering CEO, designer, engineering manager, release manager, doc engineer and QA. MIT licensed.

Repo: https://github.com/garrytan/gstack
